title: The shelf is really cute
text: The shelf is really cute. This  Metal wall shelf goes perfect with lots of decor.  It looks great in my modern farmhouse style kitchen.  I attached it to my island  and it's a great addition.  It's a durable shelf.

product_metadata.title: DII Rustic Farmhouse Bathroom Décor, Metal Storage, Small Towel Bar, Black
features: The basket itself measures 8.25 x 5.5 x 4", and the whole construction with the towel bar is 8.25 x 5.5 x 10".
This versatile wall mount shelf is perfect for any room of your home. Metal used to make this item is food safe.
Vintage style and easy maintenance of this shelf will definitely add charm to your space. Simply wipe with damp cloth when needed.
The Rustic Farmhouse look and feel of this wall mount shelf adds to your farmhouse kitchen. Use as décor or a functional piece.
This item has two hanging holes and all the necessary mounting hardware is included.
description: Crafted of antiqued finish “chicken coop” metal wire for a vintage look, and a sturdy frame, this wall mount shelf will be a great addition to your interior. Stylishly house little handy items for easy access! The towel bar would also come in handy when dinner preparation is fully on. With their rustic appeal, this shelf would make a charming housewarming gift!

details.Care instructions: Wipe clean with a soft damp cloth
